dwhAeo.intro: Fewer and fewer searches end in a list of blue links. ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Copilot answer directly, citing the sources they consider trustworthy. We prepare your site for both: ranking on Google and being the source the AI quotes.
dwhAeo.b1d: We structure content as clear questions and answers, with headings a model can follow and paragraphs that stand on their own out of context. That is what lets an AI lift your answer and attribute it to your brand.
dwhAeo.b2d: Schema.org on every page —organisation, services, frequently asked questions, reviews— so search engines and models understand what you do without inferring it from the design.
dwhAeo.b3d: With Cloudflare we decide which AI crawlers get in, one by one. The ones that bring you visibility pass; the ones that only copy content for training do not.
dwhAeo.b4d: Core Web Vitals in the green, correct semantics, sitemap, per-page metadata and clean URLs. What Google still measures.
dwhAeo.cierre: The same content working on two fronts: the search engines of always and the ones that answer in natural language.

dwhIncluido.intro: No surprises, no loose line items: the project goes live working and with everything needed to keep it running.
dwhIncluido.g1d1: When you need full autonomy to publish and manage content without depending on anyone. We build it to measure, with no bought templates and no piling up plugins.
dwhIncluido.g1d2: For sites where performance and ranking are critical: server rendering, near-instant loading and absolute control over every detail.
dwhIncluido.g1d3: The engine behind it all: APIs, integrations with your tools and the logic your site needs to do more than just display itself.
dwhIncluido.g2d1: Your site is not served directly: it goes through a global network that protects and accelerates it before anyone reaches it.
dwhIncluido.g2d2: Denial-of-service attacks are absorbed in the network before they reach the server. Your site stays up while the attack is happening.
dwhIncluido.g2d3: Content is replicated in data centres all over the world, so it loads just as fast from Madrid as from Buenos Aires or Singapore.
dwhIncluido.g2d4: HTTPS site-wide, application firewall, security headers, protection against injection and bots, and dependencies kept current. Access with the least privilege needed.
dwhIncluido.g3t1: All the code, in your GitHub
dwhIncluido.g3d1: When we finish you get the full repository with the project history. You can see what is there, audit it or take it to another team whenever you want. Nothing is locked in a box you cannot open.
dwhIncluido.g3d2: The site goes live with its hosting configured, the domain connected and the certificates in place. You do not have to contract anything yourself.
dwhIncluido.g3d3: Automatic, regular backups with tested restores. If something breaks, it rolls back in minutes.
dwhIncluido.g3d4: The changes needed to leave the site exactly as you asked for are part of the project, not extras.
dwhIncluido.plazoD: Depending on scope: a well-built landing page ships in a couple of weeks; a project with integrations, an admin panel and several languages runs to eight. The date is agreed before we start, not as we go.
